events.event: Nvidia is scheduled to report fiscal Q3 FY2027 results on 17 November after US market close, its first earnings since CEO Jensen Huang resigned on 12 November and CFO Colette Kress became interim CEO.
events.key_numbers: Earnings date 17 Nov 2026 · call 5:00 pm ET (about 04:00 WITA 18 Nov) · quarter ended 25 Oct 2026 · interim CEO Colette Kress
events.why_it_matters: Nvidia's numbers set the tone for AI and chip stocks, and for RAM and phone prices downstream.
events.spreading_evidence: detik inet cyber-life page: about 15 Nvidia/Jensen Huang headlines in the feed

events.event: detik inet reported Microsoft apologised after its Microsoft 365 and Outlook services were down for more than ten hours, with offices reverting to fax and paper.
events.key_numbers: Outage lasted 'belasan jam' (more than 10 hours) · global, Indonesian users affected
events.why_it_matters: Shows how much work and banking depends on a single cloud provider.

events.event: Donald Trump suggested Apple's Tim Cook should become Nvidia CEO to replace Jensen Huang, while detik inet reported Nvidia investors doubting he understands AI.
events.key_numbers: Huang resigned 12 Nov · Kress interim CEO
events.why_it_matters: Who runs Nvidia affects the AI chip supply the whole industry depends on.
events.spreading_evidence: detik inet featured and most-read lists

events.event: Komdigi issued three advisory letters warning government agencies of hacker attacks, as Katadata separately reported hackers drained three Indonesian financial institutions in seven hours.
events.key_numbers: 3 advisory letters · 3 financial institutions drained in 7 hours
events.why_it_matters: Attacks on banks and government systems touch ordinary people's money and data.

events.event: BNI will begin closing BNI Mobile Banking in stages from 30 November 2026, pushing customers to the newer app; this is the countdown week-ahead reminder.
events.key_numbers: Closure starts 30 Nov 2026 · 15 days left from 15 Nov
events.why_it_matters: BNI users must migrate before the old app stops working.

events.event: Harbolnas 2026 is scheduled for 10-16 December with a government transaction target of Rp40 trillion, up from Rp36.4 trillion last year (outside the 16-22 Nov window, but the Road to Harbolnas campaign is under way).
events.key_numbers: 10-16 Dec 2026 · target Rp40 trillion · 2025 Rp36.4 trillion · 14th edition
events.why_it_matters: Tells shoppers when the big year-end discounts land and what the government expects.
